name: Artemis V
short_status: Announced: lunar surface mission, anticipated by late 2028 (as of 2 November 2026); no crew or lander assigned

facts.label: Mission type
facts.value: Lunar surface mission on the standardized configuration of the SLS rocket

facts.label: Moon base
facts.value: The mission where NASA expects to begin building its Moon base

facts.label: Place in the campaign
facts.value: Follows Artemis III (LEO demonstration, 2027) and Artemis IV (first crewed landing, early 2028)

facts.label: Lander
facts.value: None assigned under the renumbered campaign; the pre-2026 Blue Moon MK2 assignment has not been re-affirmed
